The core widgets are implemented in Rust and imported from `pyzed`. They are the
building blocks of the [components](/pyzed/components/overview/).
See the [layout](/pyzed/guides/layout/) guide for sizes, padding and colors.

## Widget

### `Widget`

An immutable node of the UI tree, implemented in Rust. Returned by every widget and component function. Wherever a child is expected you can also pass a string or a number (converted to `text`) or `None` (ignored).

## Layout

### `column`

```python
column(
    children=None,
    *,
    spacing=0.0,
    padding=None,
    width=None,
    height=None,
    align=None,
    max_width=None,
    clip=False,
)
```

Stacks its children vertically.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | List of children. Nested lists are flattened and `None` and `False` are ignored, so you can write `cond and widget`. |
| `spacing` | Space between children, in pixels. |
| `padding` | Inner padding: `8`, `(vertical, horizontal)` or `(top, right, bottom, left)`. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `height` | Height: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `align` | Alignment of the children on the cross axis: `"start"`, `"center"` or `"end"`. |
| `max_width` | Maximum width in pixels. |
| `clip` | Clips content that overflows the bounds. |

```python
pz.column([pz.text("One"), pz.text("Two")], spacing=8, padding=16)
```

### `row`

```python
row(
    children=None,
    *,
    spacing=0.0,
    padding=None,
    width=None,
    height=None,
    align=None,
    clip=False,
    wrap=False,
    line_spacing=None,
)
```

Lays out its children horizontally.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | List of children. Nested lists are flattened and `None` and `False` are ignored, so you can write `cond and widget`. |
| `spacing` | Space between children, in pixels. |
| `padding` | Inner padding: `8`, `(vertical, horizontal)` or `(top, right, bottom, left)`. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `height` | Height: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `align` | Alignment of the children on the cross axis: `"start"`, `"center"` or `"end"`. |
| `clip` | Clips content that overflows the bounds. |
| `wrap` | Line wrapping / moves children to a new row when they don't fit. |
| `line_spacing` | Space between rows when `wrap=True`. |

```python
pz.row([ui.label("Name"), pz.hspace(), ui.button("OK", "ok")], align="center")
```

### `container`

```python
container(
    content=None,
    *,
    padding=None,
    width=None,
    height=None,
    max_width=None,
    max_height=None,
    align_x=None,
    align_y=None,
    center=False,
    bg=None,
    color=None,
    border_color=None,
    border_width=0.0,
    radius=None,
    shadow=None,
    clip=False,
    gradient=None,
)
```

Wraps a child to give it size, alignment, background, border, radius and shadow.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | The child (or `None` for an empty box, handy as a colored rectangle). |
| `padding` | Inner padding: `8`, `(vertical, horizontal)` or `(top, right, bottom, left)`. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `height` | Height: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `max_width` | Maximum width in pixels. |
| `max_height` | Maximum height in pixels. |
| `align_x` | Horizontal alignment: `"start"`/`"left"`, `"center"`, `"end"`/`"right"`. |
| `align_y` | Vertical alignment: `"start"`/`"top"`, `"center"`, `"end"`/`"bottom"`. |
| `center` | Centers the content on both axes and fills all the space. |
| `bg` | Background color (`"#rrggbb[aa]"`, `(r, g, b[, a])` or `"transparent"`). |
| `color` | Text or icon color. |
| `border_color` | Border color. |
| `border_width` | Border width in pixels. |
| `radius` | Corner radius: a number or `(top_left, top_right, bottom_right, bottom_left)`. |
| `shadow` | Shadow: `(color, (dx, dy), blur)`. |
| `clip` | Clips content that overflows the bounds. |
| `gradient` | Linear background gradient: `(angle, [colors])` or `(angle, [(position, color), ...])`. |

### `center`

```python
center(content, **kwargs)
```

Centers `content` in all the available space. Equivalent to `container(content, center=True)`.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | Content: a `Widget`, a string or a number (converted to text). |
| `kwargs` | Any `container` parameter. |

### `scrollable`

```python
scrollable(
    content,
    *,
    direction='vertical',
    width=None,
    height=None,
    padding=None,
    id=None,
    anchor_bottom=False,
    rail=None,
    scroller=None,
    scroller_hover=None,
    scrollbar_width=8.0,
    scroller_width=None,
    margin=0.0,
    on_scroll=None,
)
```

Makes its content scrollable.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | Content: a `Widget`, a string or a number (converted to text). |
| `direction` | `"vertical"`, `"horizontal"` or `"both"`. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `height` | Height: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `padding` | Inner padding: `8`, `(vertical, horizontal)` or `(top, right, bottom, left)`. |
| `id` | Stable identifier used to focus or scroll it with a `Command`. |
| `anchor_bottom` | Keeps the scroll pinned to the end (logs, terminals, chats). |
| `rail` | Scrollbar rail color. |
| `scroller` | Scroller color. |
| `scroller_hover` | Scroller color on hover. |
| `scrollbar_width` | Scrollbar width. |
| `scroller_width` | Scroller width (defaults to the scrollbar's). |
| `margin` | Margin between the scrollbar and the content. |
| `on_scroll` | Callable that receives a dict with `x`, `y`, `relative_x`, `relative_y`, `width`, `height`, `content_width` and `content_height`. |

### `stack`

```python
stack(children=None, *, width=None, height=None)
```

Layers its children on top of each other, the last one on top. The basis for layers, modals and notifications.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | List of children. Nested lists are flattened and `None` and `False` are ignored, so you can write `cond and widget`. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `height` | Height: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |

### `space`

```python
space(width=None, height=None)
```

Empty space of a given size.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `height` | Height: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |

### `hspace`

```python
hspace(width='fill')
```

Flexible horizontal gap: pushes the siblings in a row towards the edges.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |

### `vspace`

```python
vspace(height='fill')
```

Flexible vertical gap: pushes the siblings in a column towards the edges.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `height` | Height: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |

### `rule`

```python
rule(*, vertical=False, thickness=1.0, color=None)
```

A horizontal (or vertical) divider line.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `vertical` | Vertical line instead of horizontal. |
| `thickness` | Thickness in pixels. |
| `color` | Text or icon color. |

A horizontal rule fills the full width. Inside a column that should shrink, set `width="shrink"` on the column.

### `grid`

```python
grid(
    children=None,
    *,
    columns=None,
    max_width=None,
    spacing=0.0,
    height=None,
    aspect_ratio=None,
    width=None,
)
```

Lays out its children in a grid with a fixed number of `columns`, or as many columns of at most `max_width` as fit.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | List of children. Nested lists are flattened and `None` and `False` are ignored, so you can write `cond and widget`. |
| `columns` | Number of columns. |
| `max_width` | Maximum width in pixels. |
| `spacing` | Space between children, in pixels. |
| `height` | Height of each row. |
| `aspect_ratio` | Keeps cells at this width/height ratio. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |

```python
pz.grid([card(p) for p in photos], max_width=220, spacing=8, aspect_ratio=1)
```

### `split`

```python
split(
    first,
    second,
    *,
    ratio=0.5,
    on_resize=None,
    vertical=False,
    min_size=80.0,
    min_size_second=None,
    color=None,
    hover_color=None,
    thickness=1.0,
    handle=8.0,
    width=None,
    height=None,
)
```

Two panes with a draggable divider. For the theme style use `ui.split`.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `first` | First pane. |
| `second` | Second pane. |
| `ratio` | Proportion of the first pane (0–1). |
| `on_resize` | Callable that receives the new ratio while dragging. |
| `vertical` | Stacks the panes top/bottom. |
| `min_size` | Minimum size of the first pane. |
| `min_size_second` | Minimum size of the second pane. |
| `color` | Divider color. |
| `hover_color` | Divider color on hover or while dragging. |
| `thickness` | Line thickness. |
| `handle` | Width of the draggable area. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `height` | Height: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |

### `pin`

```python
pin(content, *, x=0.0, y=0.0, width=None, height=None)
```

Places `content` at `(x, y)` inside a box. Use it in a `stack` to position popovers and context menus.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | Content: a `Widget`, a string or a number (converted to text). |
| `x` | Horizontal position. |
| `y` | Vertical position. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `height` | Height: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |

### `responsive`

```python
responsive(function)
```

Builds its content with `function(width, height)` using the space actually available, so the layout can adapt (for example, hiding a sidebar when the window is narrow).

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `function` | Function that receives `(width, height)` and returns a widget. |

## Text and icons

### `text`

```python
text(
    content,
    *,
    size=None,
    color=None,
    font=None,
    weight=None,
    italic=False,
    line_height=None,
    align_x=None,
    align_y=None,
    width=None,
    height=None,
    wrap=True,
)
```

A piece of text.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | Content: a `Widget`, a string or a number (converted to text). |
| `size` | Font size. |
| `color` | Text or icon color. |
| `font` | `"sans"` (IBM Plex Sans), `"mono"`, `"icons"`, `"serif"` or the name of a family loaded with `load_font`. |
| `weight` | `"thin"`, `"light"`, `"normal"`, `"medium"`, `"semibold"`, `"bold"`, `"black"` or a number (100–900). |
| `italic` | Italic. |
| `line_height` | Line height relative to the size (1.0, 1.5…). |
| `align_x` | Horizontal alignment: `"start"`/`"left"`, `"center"`, `"end"`/`"right"`. |
| `align_y` | Vertical alignment: `"start"`/`"top"`, `"center"`, `"end"`/`"bottom"`. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `height` | Height: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `wrap` | Line wrapping. With `False` the text doesn't wrap. |

### `icon`

```python
icon(name, *, size=16, color=None)
```

A [Lucide](https://lucide.dev) icon. `color` defaults to the surrounding text color.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `name` | Icon name (`pyzed icons` lists them). |
| `size` | Size in pixels. |
| `color` | Color. |

```python
pz.icon("folder", size=16, color="#74ade8")
```

### `svg`

```python
svg(
    source,
    *,
    width=None,
    height=None,
    color=None,
    content_fit=None,
    opacity=1.0,
    rotation=0.0,
)
```

An SVG image.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `source` | Path to an `.svg`, the SVG code as a string (starting with `<`) or `bytes`. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `height` | Height: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `color` | If given, tints the whole SVG with that color (useful for monochrome icons). |
| `content_fit` | `"contain"`, `"cover"`, `"fill"`, `"none"` or `"scale-down"`. |
| `opacity` | Opacity from 0 to 1. |
| `rotation` | Rotation in degrees. |

## Images and content

### `image`

```python
image(
    source,
    *,
    width=None,
    height=None,
    content_fit=None,
    filter='linear',
    opacity=1.0,
    radius=0.0,
    rotation=0.0,
    scale=1.0,
    size=None,
)
```

A bitmap image (PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, WebP…) from a path or `bytes`, or raw RGBA pixels.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `source` | File path, `bytes` of the encoded file, or raw RGBA pixels with `size=(width, height)`. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `height` | Height: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `content_fit` | `"contain"`, `"cover"`, `"fill"`, `"none"` or `"scale-down"`. |
| `filter` | `"linear"` (smooth) or `"nearest"` (crisp pixels, for pixel art). |
| `opacity` | Opacity from 0 to 1. |
| `radius` | Corner radius. |
| `rotation` | Rotation in degrees. |
| `scale` | Scale. |
| `size` | `(width, height)` when `source` is raw RGBA pixels. |

```python
pz.image("photo.jpg", width=320, content_fit="cover", radius=8)
```

### `image_viewer`

```python
image_viewer(
    source,
    *,
    width=None,
    height=None,
    min_scale=0.25,
    max_scale=10.0,
    scale_step=0.1,
    filter='linear',
    size=None,
)
```

An image you can pan (by dragging) and zoom (mouse wheel), like Iced's viewer.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `source` | File path, `bytes` of the encoded file, or raw RGBA pixels with `size=(width, height)`. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `height` | Height: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `min_scale` | Minimum zoom. |
| `max_scale` | Maximum zoom. |
| `scale_step` | How much the zoom changes per wheel step. |
| `filter` | `"linear"` (smooth) or `"nearest"` (crisp pixels, for pixel art). |
| `size` | `(width, height)` for raw RGBA pixels. |

### `markdown`

```python
markdown(
    source,

    size=14.0,
    color=None,
    link_color=None,
    code_color=None,
    code_bg=None,
    on_link=None,

```

Renders Markdown (headings, lists, code blocks, quotes, tables, links…). For the theme colors use `ui.markdown`.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `source` | The Markdown text. |
| `size` | Size. |
| `color` | Text or icon color. |
| `link_color` | Link color. |
| `code_color` | Code color. |
| `code_bg` | Code background. |

| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |

### `rich_text`

```python
rich_text(
    spans,
    *,
    size=None,
    color=None,
    font=None,
    line_height=None,
    width=None,
    align_x=None,
    wrap=True,
)
```

Text made of spans with different styles. Plain strings are unstyled spans.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `spans` | List of `span(...)` or strings. |
| `size` | Size. |
| `color` | Text or icon color. |
| `font` | Font of the span or text (family name, e.g. `"IBM Plex Mono"`). |
| `line_height` | Line height. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `align_x` | Horizontal alignment: `"start"`/`"left"`, `"center"`, `"end"`/`"right"`. |
| `wrap` | Line wrapping / moves children to a new row when they don't fit. |

```python
pz.rich_text(["Click ", pz.span("here", color="#74ade8", underline=True, link=self.open), " to open."])
```

### `span`

```python
span(
    text,
    *,
    color=None,
    size=None,
    font=None,
    weight=None,
    italic=False,
    bg=None,
    radius=0.0,
    padding=None,
    underline=False,
    strikethrough=False,
    link=None,
)
```

A styled span for `rich_text`. With `link`, clicking it sends (or calls) that value.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | The text. |
| `color` | Text or icon color. |
| `size` | Size. |
| `font` | Font of the span or text (family name, e.g. `"IBM Plex Mono"`). |
| `weight` | Font weight: `"normal"`, `"medium"`, `"semibold"` or `"bold"`. |
| `italic` | If `True`, the span is drawn in italics. |
| `bg` | Background color (`"#rrggbb[aa]"`, `(r, g, b[, a])` or `"transparent"`). |
| `radius` | Background radius. |
| `padding` | Inner padding: `8`, `(vertical, horizontal)` or `(top, right, bottom, left)`. |
| `underline` | Underline. |
| `strikethrough` | Strikethrough. |
| `link` | Message or callable on click. |

### `Span`

The type of the spans created by `pz.span`.

### `qr_code`

```python
qr_code(data, *, cell_size=4.0, color=None, bg=None)
```

A QR code that encodes `data`.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `data` | The text or URL to encode. |
| `cell_size` | Size of each module in pixels. |
| `color` | Text or icon color. |
| `bg` | Background color (`"#rrggbb[aa]"`, `(r, g, b[, a])` or `"transparent"`). |

### `canvas`

```python
canvas(
    shapes=None,
    *,
    width=None,
    height=None,
    id=None,
    on_press=None,
    on_release=None,
    on_right_press=None,
    on_move=None,
    on_scroll=None,
    cursor=None,
)
```

A 2D drawing surface. `shapes` is a list created with [`pyzed.draw`](/pyzed/reference/draw/). Mouse callbacks receive coordinates relative to the canvas. With an `id`, the geometry is cached between frames and only recomputed when the shapes change. See the [drawing with canvas](/pyzed/guides/canvas/) guide.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `shapes` | List of `pyzed.draw` shapes (nested lists are accepted). |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `height` | Height: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `id` | Enables the geometry cache. |
| `on_press` | Callable that receives `(x, y)` on press. |
| `on_release` | Callable that receives `(x, y)` on release. |
| `on_right_press` | Callable that receives `(x, y)` on right click. |
| `on_move` | Called with `(x, y)` when the mouse moves. |
| `on_scroll` | Callable that receives `(dx, dy)` in lines when the wheel is used. |
| `cursor` | Mouse cursor (`"crosshair"`, `"pointer"`…). |

## Interaction

### `button`

```python
button(
    content,
    on_press=None,
    *,
    padding=None,
    width=None,
    height=None,
    bg=None,
    color=None,
    border_color=None,
    border_width=0.0,
    radius=None,
    shadow=None,
    hover_bg=None,
    hover_color=None,
    hover_border_color=None,
    pressed_bg=None,
    disabled_color=None,
    clip=False,
)
```

A button with no predefined style. For the Zed button use `ui.button`.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | Button content. |
| `on_press` | Message or callable sent on press. `None` disables the control. |
| `padding` | Inner padding: `8`, `(vertical, horizontal)` or `(top, right, bottom, left)`. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `height` | Height: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `bg` | Background color (`"#rrggbb[aa]"`, `(r, g, b[, a])` or `"transparent"`). |
| `color` | Text or icon color. |
| `border_color` | Border color. |
| `border_width` | Border width in pixels. |
| `radius` | Corner radius: a number or `(top_left, top_right, bottom_right, bottom_left)`. |
| `shadow` | Shadow: `(color, (dx, dy), blur)`. |
| `hover_bg` | Background on hover. |
| `hover_color` | Text color on hover. |
| `hover_border_color` | Border color on hover. |
| `pressed_bg` | Background while pressed. |
| `disabled_color` | Text color when disabled. |
| `clip` | Clips content that overflows the bounds. |

### `text_input`

```python
text_input(
    value,
    *,
    placeholder='',
    on_input=None,
    on_submit=None,
    id=None,
    size=None,
    font=None,
    padding=None,
    width=None,
    secure=False,
    icon=None,
    icon_size=None,
    bg=None,
    border_color=None,
    hover_border_color=None,
    focus_border_color=None,
    border_width=None,
    radius=None,
    color=None,
    placeholder_color=None,
    selection_color=None,
    icon_color=None,
)
```

A controlled text field: it shows `value` and notifies you of changes through `on_input`. For the Zed style use `ui.input`.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `value` | Current text. |
| `placeholder` | Hint text shown when empty. |
| `on_input` | Callable that receives the new text on every keystroke. |
| `on_submit` | Message or callable sent when Enter is pressed. |
| `id` | Stable identifier used to focus or scroll it with a `Command`. |
| `size` | Font size. |
| `font` | Font family. |
| `padding` | Inner padding: `8`, `(vertical, horizontal)` or `(top, right, bottom, left)`. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `secure` | Hides the text (passwords). |
| `icon` | Icon character (use `pyzed.icons.glyph(name)`). |
| `icon_size` | Icon size. |
| `bg` | Background color (`"#rrggbb[aa]"`, `(r, g, b[, a])` or `"transparent"`). |
| `border_color` | Border color. |
| `hover_border_color` | Border color on hover. |
| `focus_border_color` | Border color when focused. |
| `border_width` | Border width in pixels. |
| `radius` | Corner radius: a number or `(top_left, top_right, bottom_right, bottom_left)`. |
| `color` | Text or icon color. |
| `placeholder_color` | Placeholder color. |
| `selection_color` | Selection color. |
| `icon_color` | Icon color. |

### `mouse_area`

```python
mouse_area(
    content,
    *,
    on_press=None,
    on_release=None,
    on_right_press=None,
    on_double_click=None,
    on_enter=None,
    on_exit=None,
    on_move=None,
    on_scroll=None,
    on_middle_press=None,
    cursor=None,
)
```

Detects mouse events over its content.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | Content: a `Widget`, a string or a number (converted to text). |
| `on_press` | Left click (on press). |
| `on_release` | On releasing the left button. |
| `on_right_press` | Right click (context menus). |
| `on_double_click` | Double click. |
| `on_enter` | The mouse enters. |
| `on_exit` | The mouse leaves. |
| `on_move` | Called with `(x, y)` when the mouse moves. |
| `on_scroll` | Callable that receives `(dx, dy)` in lines when the wheel is used. |
| `on_middle_press` | Middle-button click. |
| `cursor` | `"pointer"`, `"text"`, `"grab"`, `"grabbing"`, `"crosshair"`, `"not-allowed"`, `"resize-horizontal"`, `"resize-vertical"`, `"move"` or `"default"`. |

### `hover`

```python
hover(base, top)
```

Shows `top` over `base` only while the mouse is over it (for example, a tab's close button).

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | Widget underneath. |
| `top` | Widget that appears on hover. |

### `opaque`

```python
opaque(content)
```

Makes a widget block the mouse for whatever is below it in a `stack`.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | Content: a `Widget`, a string or a number (converted to text). |

### `tooltip`

```python
tooltip(
    content,
    tip,
    *,
    position='bottom',
    gap=4.0,
    bg=None,
    color=None,
    border_color=None,
    border_width=0.0,
    radius=None,
    shadow=None,
)
```

Shows `tip` next to `content` on hover. `ui.tooltip` adds the Zed style.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | Content: a `Widget`, a string or a number (converted to text). |
| `tip` | Tooltip content. |
| `position` | `"top"`, `"bottom"`, `"left"`, `"right"` or `"cursor"`. |
| `gap` | Distance from the content. |
| `bg` | Background color (`"#rrggbb[aa]"`, `(r, g, b[, a])` or `"transparent"`). |
| `color` | Text or icon color. |
| `border_color` | Border color. |
| `border_width` | Border width in pixels. |
| `radius` | Corner radius: a number or `(top_left, top_right, bottom_right, bottom_left)`. |
| `shadow` | Shadow: `(color, (dx, dy), blur)`. |

## Code editor

### `code_editor`

```python
code_editor(
    id,
    text='',
    *,
    language='txt',
    size=14.0,
    line_height=None,
    font=None,
    width=None,
    height=None,
    padding=None,
    syntax=None,
    bg=None,
    color=None,
    selection_color=None,
    placeholder=None,
    placeholder_color=None,
    gutter=True,
    gutter_color=None,
    gutter_active_color=None,
    gutter_width=None,
    markers=None,
    wrap=False,
    on_change=None,
    on_cursor=None,
    active_line=None,
    scrollbar_color=None,
)
```

A code editor with syntax highlighting, line numbers and git markers, based on Iced's
`text_editor`. It is **uncontrolled**: `text` is only the initial value for that `id`; the
text, cursor and history live in Rust. Use `Command.set_editor_text` to replace it.
For the Zed style use [`ui.editor`](/pyzed/components/code/).

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Identifies the buffer. Reuse it to keep state across renders. |
| `text` | Initial text. |
| `language` | Language extension or name (`"py"`, `"rs"`, `"json"`…). |
| `size` | Font size. |
| `line_height` | Line height in pixels. |
| `font` | Family (monospace by default). |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `height` | Height: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `padding` | Inner padding: `8`, `(vertical, horizontal)` or `(top, right, bottom, left)`. |
| `syntax` | Map of TextMate scopes to colors (provided by `Theme.syntax_scopes()`). |
| `bg` | Background color (`"#rrggbb[aa]"`, `(r, g, b[, a])` or `"transparent"`). |
| `color` | Text or icon color. |
| `selection_color` | Selection color. |
| `placeholder` | Hint text shown when empty. |
| `placeholder_color` | Placeholder color. |
| `gutter` | Shows line numbers. |
| `gutter_color` | Line number color. |
| `gutter_active_color` | Color of the cursor line's number. |
| `gutter_width` | Gutter width (automatic by default). |
| `markers` | `{line: color}` for git markers in the gutter (lines from 1). |
| `wrap` | Line wrapping. |
| `on_change` | Callable that receives the full text after each edit. |
| `on_cursor` | Callable that receives `(line, column)`, from 1. |
| `active_line` | Background color of the cursor line. |
| `scrollbar_color` | Scrollbar color. |
